head_commit.message:
Add turn-scoped ephemeral context

Add a separate app-server turn parameter for ephemeral context and keep
it runtime-only in core. Render it in the contextual envelope as
additional_context, strip it during normal compaction, and preserve only
the active turn during mid-turn compaction.

Tests:
- cargo test -p codex-protocol
- cargo test -p codex-app-server-protocol
- cargo test -p codex-app-server
- cargo test -p codex-mcp-server
- cargo test -p codex-core ephemeral_context

Co-authored-by: Codex <noreply@openai.com>
